ships.name: Monolith
ships.description: The Monolith, the culmination of nearly a century of tireless research and construction. Rebuilt from the frame up using the colossal burnt out husk of an ancient unknown vessel found drifting along the outskirts of the Deep, the Monolith is one of the largest human spacefaring vessels ever constructed. Nothing is known about the origins of the ancient ship, except a single panel bearing an alien script that almost appears to read ACP.

ships.name: Kriegsmacher
ships.description: An absolute behemoth in terms of size. It is the pinicle of what Southbound Shipyards can produce. While it lacks advanced shield emmiters, it's sheer mass in armour makes it a veritable tank. Only a select few freeworlds captains are being offered the chance to purchase this titan. They are hoping that with this moving station patroling their space, pirates will think twice about venturing out of their holes.

ships.name: Aesalon
ships.description: The supercapital of Tarazed. A replica of this model has been featured outside of Tarazed's HQ right after it's maiden launch, though it is often getting confused with the Falcon model. It was created after the need to defend humanity from aliens arose. Thanks to a mix of some of the advanced techniques developed in the production of the Kestral, and a healty dose of looted pug tech, this blazing craft has been forged to fly the hyperlanes!
